message: The other day, I was frying up some veggies when I heard the smoke alarm go off—turns out I forgot to turn down the heat! 😅 I texted the family group chat to remind everyone about our fire escape plan, and it sparked a fun convo about our favorite pizza toppings instead. Just goes to show, a little laughter and a solid plan can really help keep things light! Have you practiced your escape plan lately?
